provenance: Per-model runtime attributes for the /nano-demo bench. Every setting that changes embedding behaviour (input cap, dtype, batch size, instruction prefixes) is read from this catalog - adding a model here is all it takes to trial it in the selector. maxInputChars is the pre-tokenisation character cap aligned to each model's tokenizer window (~4 chars/token); queryPrefix/passagePrefix are empty except for instruction-style models (e5 family) that require them for sensible scores.

models.label: all-MiniLM-L6-v2
models.notes: 6 layers, 22.7M params, 256-token window. Fastest on the WASM CPU tier.

models.label: bge-small-en-v1.5
models.notes: Xenova/bge-small-en-v1.5 ONNX q8 self-hosted at /models/bge-small-en-v1.5 (MIT). Same weights as the HF hub copy; used by /prototype so the browser never hits huggingface.co.

models.label: bge-small-en-v1.5 (HF hub)
models.notes: 12 layers, 33.4M params, 512-token window, retrieval-native training. Hub copy kept for /nano-demo A/B; production /prototype uses the self-hosted bge-small-en-v1.5 id.

models.label: bge-base-en-v1.5
models.notes: 109M params, 768-d. Trial model for the quality ceiling: fine on WebGPU desktops, slow on the 8 GB WASM tier.

models.label: e5-small-v2
models.notes: 33.4M, general retrieval family. REQUIRES query:/passage: prefixes - wired via the catalog.

models.label: e5-base-v2
models.notes: 109M e5-base: quality ladder within the prefix family. Desktop tier.

models.label: gte-small
models.notes: 33.4M, MIT, retrieval-trained, 512-token window. ONNX port ready - zero conversion.

models.label: finance2-small
models.notes: baconnier/Finance2_embedding_small_en-V1.5, ONNX q8 export self-hosted at /models/finance2-small (base bge-small, licence unstated - base MIT). Best sibling separation measured (0.79).

models.label: etiny personal-goals (fine-tuned)
models.notes: bge-small MNRL fine-tune on personal-goals triples (77, 1 epoch). CLS pooling, 256-token window. Serves the goals scan scope; exported from compliance-embeddings run pg-mnrl-47845708.

models.label: etiny pitch-decks (fine-tuned)
models.notes: bge-small MNRL fine-tune on pitch-deck triples (168, 3 epochs). CLS pooling, 256-token window. Serves the pitch-decks scan scope; exported from compliance-embeddings run spd-mnrl-48127877.
